title: Great chair, difficult (for me) to assemble
text: Great chair, difficult (for me) to assemble. Great looking chair at a very reasonable price (compared from what I can get a chair for at Office Depot). It is comfortable and stylish. Wheels and adjustable height makes this a great chair for maneuvering in a tight space (think dormitory). I am deducting a star because, as a 60 year woman who is typically competent at putting things together, found it difficult to assemble. I ended up having my nephew come over to help me. Maybe you won't have any issues, just if you are strong it might be a lot easier than it was for me. Overall, happy with the chair and I would recommend. Would make a great chair for a kid going away to school due to its price and size.

product_metadata.title: LYS Mesh Mid-Back Task Chair, Black
features: Part of the Loral Value Collection
Coil spring in padded, upholstered seat for more comfort
description: This mid-back mesh task chair offers customized positioning to maximize your comfort. Breathable mesh back conforms to your body. Padded seat with coil spring is upholstered in fabric and cushioned for a more relaxing day. Comfort functions include pneumatic seat-height adjustment, 360-degree swivel, adjustable tilt tension and tilt lock. Nylon base is equipped with dual-wheel casters for easy chair movement. Weight capacity is 250 lb.
